mapper.insert: insert into `gallery_photo` (file_key, file_name, title, mime_type, file_size, width, height, thumb_key, preview_key, album_id, uploader_id, status, nsfw, create_time) values (#{fileKey}, #{fileName}, #{title}, #{mimeType}, #{fileSize}, #{width}, #{height}, #{thumbKey}, #{previewKey}, #{albumId}, #{uploaderId}, #{status}, #{nsfw}, #{createTime})
mapper.select:
select * from `gallery_photo`
and status = #{query.status} and album_id = #{query.albumId} and album_id is null
and (album_id is null or album_id in (select album_id from `gallery_album` where password_hash is null))
and (title like concat('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') or file_name like concat('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))
and width > height + 2 and height > width + 2 and abs(cast(width as signed) - cast(height as signed)) <= 2
order by create_time desc, photo_id desc

select coalesce(sum(case when status = 0 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as all_count, coalesce(sum(case when status = 0 and width > height + 2 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as landscape, coalesce(sum(case when status = 0 and height > width + 2 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as portrait, coalesce(sum(case when status = 0 and abs(cast(width as signed) - cast(height as signed)) <= 2 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as square, coalesce(sum(case when status = 0 then file_size else 0 end), 0) as total_size, coalesce(sum(case when status = 2 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as trash_count, coalesce(sum(case when status = 1 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as hidden_count, coalesce(sum(case when status = 0 and album_id is null then 1 else 0 end), 0) as unassigned_count from `gallery_photo`
album_id = #{albumId} album_id is null
